title: P17: AdamW finish after split-QKV Muon pretraining
description: P17: switch hidden matrices from split-QKV Muon to AdamW for the final 20% of the fixed pretraining wall-clock budget, preserving the ongoing auxiliary AdamW state. A brief adaptation to the optimizer used by frozen downstream RL may improve proof discovery and transfer.
hypothesis: Muon improved all paired seeds in 030; splitting Q/K/V in incumbent 031 added only 0.67 mean solves with mixed paired changes. No prior registration tests a Muon-to-AdamW finish. Adapting hidden weights to coordinatewise AdamW updates before handoff may preserve useful Muon-learned representations while making subsequent fixed RL updates less disruptive. This optimizer-mismatch mechanism is unverified; fresh hidden AdamW moments at the boundary may instead damage useful features, and reduced time under Muon may lose its benefit. Auxiliary AdamW moments continue uninterrupted. Only the fixed downstream three-seed dev-transfer metric determines keep/discard.
expected_delta: Central prediction +3 to +15 dev-transfer solves at true length >=7 versus incumbent 031 exact mean 213.333333 (stored rounded 213), plausible downside -80. The switch begins at the first update whose elapsed fraction is >=0.8 (240 seconds of 300); there is no extra warmup or clock reset. Removing Newton-Schulz work for the last 20% may improve overall pretraining throughput by roughly 0-3%, unmeasured. Inference operations are identical; learned generation lengths may change runtime within the unchanged 1200-second total cap.

optimizer.name: split-QKV Muon hidden matrices then AdamW finish; continuous AdamW auxiliary

muon.precision: bf16 Newton-Schulz; fp32 momentum and parameters
muon.shape_scale: sqrt(max(1, rows/columns)) per orthogonalized matrix: Q/K/V each 1, attention output 1, fc1 2, fc2 1
muon.schedule: same warmup/cosine fraction as AdamW; muon_lr = 0.02 * adam_lr / 0.001
muon.parameters: All 16 hidden projection parameters remain in Muon. Four qkv.weight matrices of shape (768,256) use independent Q/K/V updates, represented as a batch of three (256,256) matrices; proj/fc1/fc2 remain unchanged.
muon.license: MIT; full copyright and permission notice retained in pretrain.py
muon.qkv_split: After elementwise Nesterov momentum, reshape each QKV update to (3,256,256); independently Frobenius-normalize and run five batched Newton-Schulz steps; reshape back before applying. No extra learning-rate multiplier. Momentum and weight decay stay elementwise and unchanged.

optimizer.adamw_parameters: emb.weight, head.weight, all projection biases and LayerNorm parameters throughout; all hidden matrices additionally from elapsed fraction >=0.8
optimizer.decay_convention: Before switch, Muon lr*0.005 equals auxiliary AdamW lr*0.1. After switch, all parameters use AdamW wd=0.1 at the existing auxiliary LR; multiplicative decay per update is preserved, integrated decay can differ with throughput.
optimizer.clipping: joint global gradient norm 1.0 before both optimizers
optimizer.handoff: standard GPT weights only; pretraining optimizer states are discarded and frozen RL creates its own unchanged AdamW

adamw_finish.parameters: all 16 hidden projection matrices added once to existing auxiliary AdamW optimizer
adamw_finish.lr: same scheduled auxiliary LR, nominal peak 0.001; no restart or additional warmup
adamw_finish.state: hidden matrices start fresh first/second moments; auxiliary state is retained
adamw_finish.muon_state: no Muon updates after switch; buffers local to pretrain only
